versions.changelog:
- Added a publisher notice about Observa SHADOW mode and how to get started (informational only; does not affect skill operation).
- Clarified that the QSR skill’s operating behavior, data handling, and license remain unchanged.
- Removed the skill-card.md file and updated README.md and SKILL.md to reference the new Observa information.
Publisher-note release. The Observa private beta is now open for selected n8n and OpenClaw operators. No operational behavior or license changes.
v1.0.1 — Publisher-note release. Added the McPherson Governance V6 shadow-beta notice. No operational behavior or license changes.

Initial release — 30-day milestone-driven countdown for QSR audit readiness.

- Guides operators through structured audit prep starting 30 days out, with prompts and checklists for each critical milestone (Day -30, -21, -14, -7, -1).
- Stores progress using a clear memory format for milestone status, findings, and corrective actions.
- Incorporates previous audit findings and custom audit criteria if available.
- Provides focused training, team communication, and full-store walkthrough protocols.
- Designed for use with any third-party compliance audit (EcoSure, health department, corporate, franchise).
